142922.overview: Sega Rally was a major success in the arcades, bringing rally-style racing to the masses before the Colin McRae games. Four detailed tracks have been created, with a succession of stomach-churning bends and jumps, and you can choose from 3 different cars. As well as the main championship, there is a time-trial mode featuring a ghost car to beat, so you always know how your run compares with your best-ever. Two machines can be linked for multi-player action. The handling of the cars is unrealistic, to put the focus on action and instant playability.

142923.overview:
Create and customize the appearance and personality of your Sim, then move into SimValley, the offbeat setting of the game, in this portable version of the simulation series. Make your way through the adventure, meeting odd people such as Uncle Hayseed, Olde Salty, and Mad Willy Hurtzya, but don't forget to take care of your motives, go to the bathroom, and grab something to eat.

Advance in five missions, starting at the Hayseed Farm and ending in the palatial SimValley mansion. New elements let players shop, keep an inventory, and have actual conversations with the residents of the town.

142924.overview: Sonic is back to save the world! The evil Dr. Eggman is at it again, with a brand new scheme to trip up Sonic and his pals. Maneuver your way through obstacles, puzzles and traps to collect the chaos emeralds and defeat the vile Dr. Eggman before it's too late!

142925.overview:
Dr. Otto Octavius is an egomaniacal scientist that was conducing an experiment, but it failed in an accident which turned him on villain Dr. Octopus (a.k.a. Doc Ock). Now he seeks revenge on the one he holds responsible for humiliating him: Spider-Man.

The N-Gage version of Spider-Man 2 is a 2D platformer, with some 3D races against time between the 2D stages. In the 3D races Spider-Man needs to move higher or lower between buildings to avoid obstacles. The 2D levels are more traditional: climbing walls and ceilings, slinging web at opponents, taking pictures for the Daily Bugle newspaper, using spider sense to reveal secrets etc. The events are loosely based on the story of the Spider-Man 2 movie. The game offers fifteen 2D levels, five 3D levels, some Spider-Man comics' classical villains as bosses (like The Lizard, Rhino, and Doc Ock) and a scoreboard on N-Gage Arena.

142926.overview:
SSX Out of Bounds is the first handheld game in the series. Fully 3D, this snowboarding game allows you to race against computer-controlled opponents as well as locally against three other players, all requiring an N-Gage and this game. The game allows you to choose from ten different characters, each with their own strengths and weaknesses.

It also features a Shadow Racing mode that allows you to race against the best times of another player, downloaded from the N-Gage Arena, though no direct multiplayer can be played online. The N-Gage arena will also supply you with trick tips.

In order to unlock new areas and equipment, you must meet certain requirements that are achieved through performing various tricks and hitting certain high scores. Performing tricks involves simply shifting your body-weight while in the air, and pressing an additional button. The more varied your combos, the higher the score. Performing the same trick over and over again yields diminishing results. Tricks are also of use in the regular races, as they provide you with boost capabilities.

142927.overview: Based on the GameCube series of the same name, Super Monkey Ball has you in control of 3D style arenas, each with a varying degree of difficulty and objectives. Your little monkey, inside a ball, relies on your movement of the arena to get to the required objectives (collecting items, getting to the finish line in under a certain time limit, etc.).

142930.overview:
System Rush is a futuristic racing game with strong hints of Wipeout series. Though the goal is the same as in any other racer - to finish in a first place, you don't pilot a physical vehicle in it, but a virtual one inside one of the four world global network. And your opponents are also programs and defense systems, as well as opposing hackers whose net you are trying to crack.

The game sports a striking visual look mixing hints of futuristic Wipeout design, low-poly tracks as in F-Zero and neon vector graphics reminiscent of the early 80s arcade games and the movie Tron. Each one of the four networks - European, Russian, South American and United States has their distinctive color schemes, musical tracks, track layouts and also different flyers. Vehicles has four different parameters: speed, drift, handling and aero. While, the first three are obvious, the last one is quite unique, as each one of the flyers can take off and glide for some time. It could be used to avoid obstacles, gather power-ups and take over your enemies.

Beside the story mode, where the goal is to hack each of the four global networks, there are also more typical Grand Prix tournament, single races and a multiplayer game.

143105.overview:
A new generation of Snakes comes to the N-Gage platform -- available as a free download, this latest incarnation of the world's most famous mobile game will infect N-Gage game deck users with that familiar Snakes desire to see how long you can go. Players must navigate each level, searching for power boosts, travel along power paths and stay alert to avoid obstacles across 42 levels of action - some levels are double-sided, forcing players to play both sides.

Multiplayer games will quickly turn into a slippery session with support for up to 4 players via Bluetooth wireless technology. Players can start their own viral outbreak by sharing their "infection" with other N-Gage owners -- a full copy of Snakes can easily be transmitted by Bluetooth connection.

425880.overview: Space Impact Evolution X is a shoot 'em up game where the player can collect power-ups, collect extra lives and take down enemy shapes.  It is the sequel to the original Space Impact game and game bundled with the N-Gage Classic and the N-Gage QD (on the "Extras" folder of the Support CD).

453977.overview: An action RPG based on the famous Chinese historical novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Players can control Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei, switching between them to utilize their unique weapons and abilities. The game starts with the Yellow Turban Rebellion and follows key events from the novel, such as battles against Hua Xiong and Lu Bu.

472204.overview: Combat racing game developed by Fathammer (Sweden) for Nokia. While completed for N-Gage, it was never released as an official MMC card title. Instead, it was released as a standard Symbian S60 game and reviewed on All About Symbian. The N-Gage version was also released on Tapwave Zodiac. A finalised N-Gage beta was preserved by the community (French homebrew team QueenMeka) in 2020.
